synth.notes:
Player moves 3 per arrow inside an invisible FLOOR: room (30,30,30,30) + upper corridor (18,30,12,6) + lower corridor (15,42,15,9) + neck (6,42,9,6).
If the player would step onto a block, it stays put and the block is kicked: it slides 3 per step and picks up any block its shifted rect hits.
The whole chain stops when any member would leave the floor, overlap the player, or enter the interior of a socket it does not fit (socket box minus its 1px border, size mismatch).
A click on a block gives the player that block's rect and removes the block; blocks are renamed token_i by (y,x). No hidden state is needed.
Step 78 is explained by the upper corridor x18-29, y30-35. Not confirmed: floor beyond the observed stops, what happens when a fitting block enters a socket, and actions 5 and 7.
